before: A page- or margin-positioned table on the first sheet of a continuous section broke at the continued section's own bottom margin, so it could run past the margin of the sheet it shares with the section before.
after: The table breaks at the bottom margin of the sheet it is on, which the earlier section sets. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
